venues.weather: Weather and Dry January probably got us tonight but thats okay! Made a lot of good connections and got to spend one on one time with some nice guests

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Wednesday 1/14.** Gentle but respectable start thanks to a 7 top that ordered most of the food menu and multiple rounds, including daiquiri variations curated by Sean; a few investor tables were strong (one into four rounds). 8pm turn solid but never fully sat; an 8 top late put the night over the top. Comps $103 (2%). Door: buzzing Wednesday, slow start from train delays and a Verizon outage causing partially arrived groups; busy only at 9:45 with a wave of twos and brief waitlist; two waitlist parties befriended each other at Amor and were seated together; 11:30 wave with a 5, 6 and 8 top (tables joined); many walk-in birthdays. No no-shows. Kitchen: lots of arancini fans. Repairs: kitchen doors clap loudly (disturb T9/10), T6 top missing two screws, downstairs bathroom sink clogged.
